name: V Villas Phuket - MGallery Collection
short_description: An intimate 19-villa resort perched 39 metres above secluded Ao Yon Bay in Cape Panwa, every villa with a private infinity pool and 24-hour butler.
ai_summary: V Villas Phuket - MGallery Collection is an intimately sized resort of just 19 villas perched 39 metres above secluded Ao Yon Bay in the Cape Panwa area, away from Phuket's busier tourist zones. Most villas span two storeys with three or four bedrooms, dazzling ocean views, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a private infinity pool, all supported by 24-hour personal butler service. Guests consistently describe the property as a sanctuary of elegance, praising the Yon Ocean House restaurant, the rooftop Akoya Star Lounge, and exceptional staff, with the main trade-off being that the cliffside setting requires stairs or a golf cart to reach the beach.

faqs.question: How many villas does V Villas Phuket have?
faqs.answer: Just 19 villas, most spanning two storeys with three or four bedrooms and ocean views over Ao Yon Bay -- every villa includes a private infinity pool and 24-hour personal butler service.

faqs.question: Is V Villas Phuket directly on the beach?
faqs.answer: Not directly -- the resort is perched 39 metres above Ao Yon Bay on a cliffside in Cape Panwa, so reaching the beach involves stairs or a golf cart, a trade-off for the dramatic ocean views.

reviews.title: V Villas Phuket - MGallery: A Hotel Review of an Unforgettable Luxury Getaway
